faq.question: Where can Amazon video be used?
faq.answer: Video can support product detail pages and Amazon advertising placements such as Sponsored Brands and DSP, depending on eligibility and campaign setup.

faq.question: Do you publish average video CTR or CVR lifts?
faq.answer: No. We do not invent video-specific performance averages. Success is scoped by placement, creative quality, and how video supports the listing and media plan.

faq.question: Do you script videos before filming?
faq.answer: Yes. We start with objectives, proof points, and a storyboard so production time focuses on the scenes that matter.

faq.question: Can you adapt existing footage?
faq.answer: Often yes. We review source footage for Amazon fit and identify what can be recut versus what needs new capture.

faq.question: How long should Amazon listing videos be?
faq.answer: Length depends on product complexity and placement. We prioritize early clarity and shopper questions over long brand films.

faq.question: Do videos need to match listing copy?
faq.answer: Yes. We align on-screen messaging with approved listing claims and A+ content so the page feels consistent.

faq.question: Which Amazon marketplaces do you support?
faq.answer: We support creative work for catalogs selling across official Amazon Seller Central marketplaces: United States, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, United Kingdom, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Netherlands, Belgium, Ireland, Sweden, Poland, Turkey, United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, South Africa, India, Japan, Australia, and Singapore. Placement availability can differ by market; scope is confirmed during your audit consultation.

faq.question: How do I get started?
faq.answer: Submit the free audit form or contact us at +1 (360) 660-1210 or info@ecomgliders.com. Typical next steps are a placement brief, storyboard, then production and listing or ad upload support.
